records.source: NOAA NCEI ETOPO 2022 15 arc-second bed elevation (DOI 10.25921/fd45-gt74); full native-grid request and statistics in docs/research/FLIGHT14_OCEAN_COVERAGE_2026-11-06.json, additionalRegions.
records.variant: Disjoint verified ocean operating regions for the Flight 14 engineering return profile
records.conditions: 20..22 degrees N, 164..162 degrees W; all 230,400 native cells sampled with skipX=skipY=1 and no missing cells. Elevations -5307..-1786.89 m. Runtime coverage is the union with the separately verified main rectangle, not an enclosing rectangle across nearby islands. The separate east-of-Kauai rectangle, 22..22.3 degrees N and 159..158 degrees W, screens all 17,280 native cells without skips or missing cells; elevations -4927.50..-1692.27 m. It includes the propagated isolated and moving-world crossings after fragmentation-momentum correction. The adjoining north-of-Oahu rectangle, 22..22.3 degrees N and 158..157.5 degrees W (screened 2026-11-10), samples all 8,640 native cells without skips or missing cells; elevations -4936.96..-3970.32 m. It covers the moving-world crossing once the Kepler-world frame carries the Moon's pull on Earth. Kauai, Oahu and the unscreened gaps remain excluded.
records.uncertainty: Finite-raster geographic screening only, not a navigation or collision-mesh product. No measured landing coordinates, steering target or relaxed speed/attitude/resource acceptance is asserted.
